LanguageData.Gun_SA_vz58V_RWP.label: SA vz. 58 V
LanguageData.Gun_SA_vz58V_RWP.description: The SA vz. 58 V is a Czech-made selective fire carbine known for its reliability and robustness. Chambered in 7.62×39mm, it features a distinct design with a gas-operated action and a short-stroke piston. While it bears a superficial resemblance to the AK-47, its internal mechanics set it apart. Ideal for medium-range engagements, it offers a balanced mix of firepower and accuracy, making it a versatile choice for skilled operators.
